LOOK BEYOND THE FOUR WALLS.

KNOW YOUR NEIGHBOURHOOD

A little more information.
A more informed move.

A comfortable home starts with understanding the area around it. Look for dated observations, and visit the home before deciding.

  • Street lighting, entry locks & gated access
  • Security guard or CCTV, where available
  • Nearby transport, hospital & police station
  • Owner-reported details, clearly labelled

Area observations are not a guarantee of personal safety. Unchecked details stay marked “unknown”.

A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Before you move.

Need a hand? Harsh can help you
understand the next step.

+91 84390 94727 ↗
Are these real homes available to book?

Listings labelled “Sample home” are illustrative and cannot be booked for real. The partner demo lets you simulate the process. Real homes appear only after owner submission and admin review. Check the availability and review date on each listing.

What is included in the monthly price?

The monthly total is the rent only. Electricity is extra according to actual usage and the bill. These samples use 1 month rent + 3 months advance, with no separate security deposit or service fee. Advance is credit for the next three months. The owner must confirm these in an itemised quote.

Does “observations checked” mean the area is safe?

It means specific observations were recorded and checked on the stated date. It does not guarantee safety. Visit the area at your usual travel time and discuss concerns with the owner and local residents.

Do I need to upload Aadhaar?

This website does not accept identity-document uploads. Do not send Aadhaar, bank details or passwords through the enquiry form. Any necessary identity verification must be arranged separately with clear consent and an appropriate alternative.

Can I cancel a request?

You can cancel an unpaid request before a payment order is created. For an existing payment order, payment or refund, contact support. Any charges and refund conditions must be supplied in your written quote before you pay.
